images.prompt: Camera and composition: close-up, eye level, one person's face and shoulders fill most of the frame; the related scene stays softly blurred in the background. Keep the top fifth of the image as softly blurred or plain background (a title band goes there). A Korean man in his 30s wearing a mustard sweater looking at a pot of leftover stew on the stove in a cozy evening kitchen, the pot softly blurred behind him. Expression: curious, head slightly tilted. Color theme: apricot and ivory tones with a sage green accent. Soft matte clay 3D render, rounded chunky shapes, handmade plasticine texture, gentle studio lighting, miniature diorama feel, richer and more saturated colors than pastel, clear contrast, cozy and warm mood. Base colors cream, apricot, mint, sky blue and warm brown, a little deeper than pastel. Add one bright accent color (coral-red, mustard yellow or cobalt blue) on the main person's clothing or the key object. Korean people and Korean everyday settings. Show only what the image's own scene describes; do not repeat the post's main object in every image. Topic-specific details (medical, tools, places) are welcome where the scene calls for them. Everyone looks calm and relaxed — smiling, or thoughtful and curious; nobody is in pain, sad or scared. Do not draw any written words, letters or numbers anywhere in the image; signs, posters, screens and papers stay blank or use simple icons only. No money, banknotes, coins or currency symbols anywhere.
